title: Questions 151-152 refer to the following advertisement.
passage_1:
Name Our New Blend!

Fernbrook Tea House is looking for a memorable name for our new spiced autumn blend! We want a name that suggests warmth, comfort, and the changing season.

How to Enter:

  • Pick up an entry form at the checkout counter.
  • Write your suggested name and your contact details.
  • Post the form into the copper tin beside the door.

The winning name will be chosen by our regional manager, and the customer who suggested it will receive a £150 gift card valid for everything we sell in the shop.
